description: Submits a game's newest version that passed the server autotest (state tested) for manual review by Gamealia, with release notes. Call it only after the user has confirmed they want to submit this version, and after gamealia_upload_version (skip it if that ran with submit:true). When the game is already live (an update), notes are required: a short changelog of what changed in this version (at least 10 characters), written from the code diff or your own work and confirmed with the user. Needs login; fails if no version is tested, if an update has no release notes, or if newly requested permissions lack a justification. Returns the version, normally awaiting_review; if permissions changed since its autotest the server re-tests it first. Then check gamealia_get_status later.

game.description: Game slug or id, from gamealia_list_games (a game of the active account)

notes.description: Release notes: a short changelog of what changed in this version (new content, fixes, balance or control changes), 2000 characters max. The reviewer reads them first. REQUIRED (at least 10 characters) to submit an update to a game that is already live (liveVersionId set); optional for the first submission. Write them from the code diff or your own work since the live version, and confirm them with the user

name: gamealia_submit_for_review
title: Submit for review
